body:
If we have any missing features already does itself, we must fully add support for them into agent-commander, so we in our scope of controlling external agents have full support of all the features necessary for both github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind and https://github.com/krl-gr/upcomputer but only what is general between them, we should not support features that are too specific to either of projects, only universal features that are needed for agents control in general.

Also our code must be maximum configurable and extensible, so if features are missing or bugs are present each project can just replace failing or missing part and redevelop it temporary, so all workarounds are easy to develop without any wait time for delivery in this repository.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Research if https://github.com/krl-gr/upcomputer can benefit from agent-commander library
